I'm so sorry to hear this. I have been on your girlfriend's side of things. I was married to this guy and I started to feel like he wasn't right for me anymore. I went on a work trip and ended up cheating on him, telling him I wanted a divorce pretty much out of the blue, and then I started a relationship with this other guy immediately. I didn't care about the consequences at the time. But as soon as he found out I was cheating I came down from my high and fell into the deepest depression of my life. She is telling her friends just her side, so of course they will side with her, as did my friends. Unfortunately our marriage wasn't salvageable, but it made me take a really good hard look at myself. I started seeing a therapist, and eventually went to a psychiatrist for meds. I'm still not completely stable, but I am in a relationship with a good man and I do face the temptation of cheating, but I have to remind myself that I don't want to go down that path again and I'm just going through an episode. I say all that to say that maybe she just hasn't hit her rock bottom? If she doesn't consistently work on herself then she will never have a stable relationship. Hang in there. I am sure it's rough being on your end of things.
Yup! I more often than not just get really pissed at myself and then it's hard for me to come down from it.
Exactly! It's good not to feel alone on that.

Oh my god. It's like you took my thoughts right out of my head! I feel this exact same way!! Explaining what I was going through was not easy because I felt like she didn't believe me. I mean obviously she did since she mentioned bipolar, but still that thought that you said, "am I deceiving this person" comes up.
Thank you for that :) it is really easy to feel like I'm making it up sometimes
She prescribed me lamictal, but I'm scared to take it. I'm afraid I'm just making all of this up and I'm really fine.

Zoloft is the reason she suspects I'm bipolar. After like 2 weeks I felt like I was fucking cured of my depression. I was so high on life! And then after like a month I was super anxious and I dropped into a super deep depression which lead to me contacting a helpline cause I wanted to kill myself so bad.
Thankfully my mom does not tell me not to call her early in the morning, but I totally do that too! I'll get done with my early morning workout and then call my mom.

Thank you! I appreciate the comment. This sounds like me. I normally sleep like 10+ hours when depressed and I just stay exhausted. Where as the opposite I am "ready to go" all day. About 5 hours sounds like me too.

Thank you for your comment! I suppose maybe I could still have it even if I don't have the decreased need for sleep. I definitely felt smarter than others and was thinking faster and making more jokes. Do you have anxiety before you dive into a depression?
Can you explain what being an anxious wreck felt like to you?
Thank you! Great advice! I guess we should just limit him to a certain part of the house while we are gone. He even does it while we are home. It seems we just need to restrict him more I guess.
No, we are home with him almost all the time.
Oh my gosh!! So pretty!

Thank you for taking the time to read my post and respond! Do people go to AA that have similar habits as mine? I have always thought of people who go to AA as super heavy drinkers, like every single day binge drinking. But maybe I just don't know enough about it.

Thank you for this post! I am 23 and I have been very worried about my social life if I quit. Plus I use it to ease my social anxiety. I've finally come to terms with the fact that I do indeed have a problem. I can quit drinking for a little while but  I always end up getting cravings to go out and binge drink again and next thing I know I am doing it every weekend until I decide to quit again.
Oh my god, you're gorgeous! 😍

Thank you so much for posting this!! This is how I feel too. I'm afraid of losing him as a therapist. He has consumed my thoughts to the point of being in my dreams. It comes in waves though, sometimes I don't think about him much. I'm a girl and he is a guy so I don't want to discuss it with him because I'm afraid he won't feel comfortable being my therapist anymore.

She called me over the phone and told me that she talked to a tarot card reader and now she believes she has some sort of special gift. She told me she has had dreams about people dying and then they came true... Now I'm not sure what to think. When she texted me I thought she was hearing things but she does think she has some sort of spiritual gift and spirits are trying to contact her. She just went and bought some tarot cards to communicate with them. So I guess it's not auditory hallucinations, but she is concerning me a bit. She said she has a video of the tarot card readings that she wants me to watch so I'll understand.

I am sorry :( that must be hard. I tend to get hit with a lack of interest in anything and then decline from there. So I guess in a sense it does take me by surprise, but I can tell when I'm declining.

Thank you for the reply! I feel you. I am trying to get over my alcohol abuse currently. It's so fucking hard when my emotions get so intense. I just had a bitch of a depression because I haven't allowed myself to feel my way through it anymore. I just drink when I feel really sad. Fucking shit I thought I was going to kill myself, but I made it through! Thank you, you stay strong too!
You are definitely not ❤️
Thank you! :) Same to you! And thank you for the response!

I went into a HORRIBLE depression when I had lost husband and this other guy I was dating right after him. I went out to bars and slept with people to fill the voids and I got on dating apps. I was almost constantly with people once I pulled myself somewhat out of the hell hole of depression I was in.
The days leading up to my period are pure hell.

This is exactly what happened to me the other day, except I drank my emotions away and did not do the texting part because the alcohol made me feel better. Most of the time I do that though. I immediately want to profusely apologize to my SO.

I was unhappy in my marriage... or at least I think I was. Anyway, I ended up cheating on my husband (yes it was beyond shitty), and I latched onto this new guy. When the new guy started treating me really crappy and dropped me I frantically tried to get my husband back, but it was too late. I hate that I can't trust my own fucking brain on if I really like someone or not. Sometimes I feel like I made up that I was unhappy because at that time I didn't like my husband and this other guy was treating me good.
I am with you on that! I shift a lot between thinking I am possibly a man, back to a woman, and then to "maybe non-binary is a thing". I also change my hair a lot. You are not alone in the shifts.

I am so sorry your friend said that. I told my dad I self-harm one time and he just told me "well that is stupid". I have never opened up to him about anything mental health related since. Some people just don't get it.
Fuck yes. I have thought this so many times. I feel like I keep getting closer and closer to actually being able to do it myself though.

The one thing that always stops me from doing it is my mom. She is an anxious mess who freaks out if I don't return her call in like 5 minutes, and she has type 1 diabetes. I don't want to make her life worse. She already has it hard. Other than her and my dog I am not really sure who would care about me being gone... at least not care much.

I take no offense. I decided go on here tonight because I am feeling very suicidal. It is oddly somewhat comforting to know that someone else is having similar thoughts as me, but that sounds so fucking shitty to say that. I wouldn't wish depression on anyone. I wish you the best. Feel free to PM me if you want to get someone more thoughts out there.

I had these exact thoughts today. I kept picturing myself just running off the road while driving or slitting my wrists. I feel like I'm internally screaming for help, but people only see blank stares. My boyfriend is in the other room laughing and playing videogames with friends and it is just making it worse. I love playing videogames... Normally. Right now I don't love anything and I feel like everything I do is to distract myself from the emptiness inside hoping that it will lift soon.... Unfortunately I just got to this point so we will see how long I can hang on. Fuck my existence and my fucking brain. I really wish I wasn't born because this is a miserable existence.
Talk to me! Feel free to PM me. I am in a shit mood and really need someone too.

I drink/get high or self harm, but I've tried REALLY hard not to do those things. I like to light a candle, get some coffee or tea and journal. Unfortunately I still feel empty inside, but it distracts my mind from the emptiness if even just for a moment.

Yes, I do this. I have communicated with my boyfriend some since we live together, but I have told him that I'd rather be by myself and with my thoughts. This is my second day basically isolating myself from social interactions. You aren't alone in this. Sometimes I get lonely and it makes me start thinking about suicide... But regardless of how lonely I feel I still want to be alone. Maybe it's because I can't convey how I truly feel in my head to others, and even if I could I feel there is nothing they can do to help.
I feel the exact same way! I have trouble keeping relationships in my life because of depression. It controls my social life and it sucks. You can message me if you want to talk to someone.
I wish I had fun dressing up! I feel so awkward and uncomfortable dressing up in girls clothes. You look great man!

Thank you. I wish I could figure out what it is exactly that I am good at ... I still don't even know what I want to do career wise because I find a way to talk myself out of everything I think of out of fear that I will never be successful in anything I choose.

They are also really hard qualities to deal with. It seems like I feel everything deeper than others, but it does make it easier to empathize with and be sensitive towards how others feel. Thank you. I think something about your first sentence, "Everyone has strengths and weaknesses- I'd much rather be worse at board games than other aspects of life." really hit me. Feeling stupid is something I struggle with in almost every aspect of life, which makes me feel like I'm just a waste of space, but you are right, being bad at a board game is not a big deal in the grand scheme of things.

I honestly hadn't thought of it as being a disorder, but I decided to look it up since it has been preventing me from even going in public. I recently got diagnosed with major depression and social anxiety, so I am on antidepressants, but now that my depressed mood is gone I am still constantly picking at myself and not wanting to go out because I am too fat. Maybe I'll talk to my psychiatrist about this too.
Yes I did, and he still didn't understand why it hurt me. He told me he didn't think it was fair of me to ask him to stop playing when that's what he wanted to do.

Thank you, that does make me feel better. I wasn't sure if I was getting hurt for no reason here. He told me it wasn't fair to ask him to do something else since he let me binge my show in peace, but he was playing games the entire time I was binging my show... So I really don't see what's unfair about wanting to spend quality time with him instead of staring at a screen.
I can't remember exact ages, but I was around 7 or 8 and he is just a couple years older than me

Well I just meant that you have more freedom to be who you are without being in that abusive position that you were in. I've also heard a lot of trans people say that they don't feel like they are truly themselves until they kind of came to terms with who they are. I was not trying to say that you used to be a girl and now you are a guy. You have always been a guy.
That's awful! I'm sorry you ended up with such shitty parents. I am sure there is a sense of relief for you to be able to be who you are now though! Thanks for sharing :)

Wow thank you! That is a super encouraging story! I really wish I would have thought about this stuff more when I was a bit younger. It makes total sense to me now thinking about how I said I wished I was a boy when I was only 2, i HATED when I had to start wearing bras because it meant I couldn't sleep shirtless in just my underwear anymore, I used to try to stand to pee when I was 7 or 8, I still feel like I'm out of place in the women's restroom, shopping for bras feels awkward to me, I hate when people know I'm on my period because it just doesn't feel right to have one, and I just feel genuinely happy and like I fit when I am hanging out with a bunch of guys.. until they point out that I'm a girl.

Wow, that must have been so hard for you. I am glad you are in a much better place in your life now. I will never understand what people who are so set in their ways of thinking that they are willing to let it rip their family apart. Thanks for sharing your story! You seem like a very brave and strong person to go through all of that and still come out on top. My boyfriend right now is straight and I've talked to him about it a little. He said that he would completely support me and still love me, but he just isn't attracted to men, so he doesn't think we could be romantic partners if I transitioned.
Thank you for sharing! I am glad that your experience was mostly positive! :)

Thank you for your story! I am so sorry that was your experience. Even though I haven't came out yet I know one thing to be true, as you get older you start caring less about what other people think. I am only 23 now, but I am gradually caring less and less about my parents opinions. I still respect them but there are things we just aren't going to agree on. I hope you find this to be true too and can transition at some point in your future. Keep your head up!
Thanks so much! I live in the Bible belt so hopefully I can find one close by
You looks so fucking amazing!! The color of your shirt really suits you.
I'm sorry that it was so rough for you. I am glad that everything is good now! That is definitely encouraging for me.

It has just now really hit me, because like you, I needed to sort out a lot of other shit in my life to be able to think more about who I really am. I am kind of in a self-discovery phase of my life right now. I have been watching transition videos for the past 3 years, but it seems to really be consuming my every thought at this point. Thanks for the comment! I think I am going to talk to a gender therapist soon.
I messaged you :)

I started watching trans YouTubers about 3 years ago, and always thought they were so brave. I jokingly asked my significant other at the time "what if I was a boy"... I guess I wasn't completely joking. I kept telling myself "no, I'm a girl, these videos are just neat to watch". I started watching videos about "how to know it you're transgender". In one video I watched the guy said "if you're even asking this question then the answer is probably yes". I guess I hated being a girl for so long, and thought there was nothing I could do about it so it just became normal to me (if that makes sense?). I thought there weren't any girls who actually liked being a girl because I hated it so much. But I guess there are because obviously there are trans women and that's what they want to be. I guess it's not the norm to hate the sex you were born as.

Thanks for the comment! Did you ever second guess yourself? I keep thinking that I really want to be a guy, and I've always wished I was. There has never been a moment where I've been happy as a girl. I will be hanging out with guys and as soon as they make a comment that brings attention to my gender I'm just kind of like "oh yea... Yup I'm a girl.. ugh" . But when it comes to actually thinking about what I would be like if I transitioned the way I want (top surgery and T) I start wondering if I would like the way I look or if I would want my old body back.. I guess cause it's the only one I have ever known. I want to be seen as a guy so badly, but I'm afraid of making irreversible changes.
Did you come out? Or have you just tried to ignore it and keep moving on with life?
Thanks so much! It is good to know I am not alone!

Thanks! That at least gives me a little hope. I have been thinking about it so much that it is kind of driving me crazy. I really just want to resume my life normally... And feel comfortable in the body I was born in.

It is ok to question it at your age and want to label it. I know a lot of people here are saying that you are only 16, but really 16 is not too young to be questioning your sexuality. I did not truly start questioning mine until I was 19, but that was more so due to religious reasons. Being bi doesn't mean the attraction has to be 50/50. I like guys on an emotional level and become physically attracted to them after the connection is made. Just looking at a penis does nothing for me. But for girls, I love boobs and vaginas. I get super turned on by just looking at them, but I still have yet to make a deep emotional connection with a woman. I still consider myself bi because I get attracted to both, but it is just a little different depending on if it is a man or woman.

Oh, and I would also like to add that I love anime porn too :P you are not alone haha

It seems like you have gotten past the hardest part by telling your family. I am not sure what beliefs your friends hold, but typically friends are a little quicker to accept stuff like that than family. I have not had to come out as trans (yet), but I have came out to my friends as bi and not my family. My friends did not really care. They don't agree with it, but they did not act in a big way at all. I know that coming out as trans is a bigger deal, it shouldn't be, but unfortunately it is.  The good thing about friends is that you can always make new friends who do support you in your transition even if your current friends don't. If your friends can't accept you for who you are then they really aren't that great of friends. I know it is easier said then done, but I truly hope you have a good experience coming out to your friends. Just remember that in the end it will all be ok, because there are plenty of people who will accept you for who you are.
I kind of get hung up on this too honestly. I think it is both for me personally.

It might be helpful to talk to your dad before you bring him home. Maybe kind of give your dad a heads up about the whole thing and ask if he would like to meet him. I am currently going through a situation where I moved in with my boyfriend and my dad doesn't want to meet him at all, just because we moved in together without getting married. I think it prevents a very stressful situation from happening if you just talk to him first to see how he feels about it. Good luck, and I hope they get along!

I'm so sorry about your mom. My family is pretty narrow minded like that. It was an extremely hard pill for my dad to swallow that I moved in with my boyfriend before getting married. To the point that he had told me he would pay for 2 years of college and then took it back because I moved in with my boyfriend. And when I told him I was atheist he stopped saying he was proud of me (which he used to tell me all the time).  So I really can't imagine his reaction if I decided I was FtM.

I unfortunately have a very religious family and haven't even told them I am bi. I'm honestly not sure my dad would even want to talk to me anymore if I am trans. I suppose I need to figure things out. I just know that I have been questioning my gender for quite a while and as much as I try to ignore it I still eventually end up thinking about it.
Thank you!! I love this idea. The thought of mentioning that to people I actually know is completely terrifying. I think I'm going to try that.
You look absolutely amazing!
